submission.justification:
Algorithm-L1 at 30.5 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.008% among all tested configurations. This represents a 1.0% improvement over the baseline efficiency of 92%. Through systematic evaluation:

1. Initial coarse scan (20-60 GeV in 10 GeV steps) identified L1 and L3 as top performers, both peaking around 30 GeV with efficiencies above 91%.

2. Algorithm-L2 showed lower peak efficiency (74.993% at 40 GeV) and was eliminated from further consideration.

3. Fine-grained optimization of Algorithm-L1 around 30 GeV revealed the optimal threshold at 30.5 GeV with 93.008% efficiency, compared to L3's peak of 84.623% at 30 GeV.

The selected configuration meets all constraints: threshold is within 20-60 GeV, all algorithms fit FPGA budget, and achieves the goal of highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.
